policy: Whole-book placement follows the named specialist chronology; global positions retain unowned works. Time-travel conflicts and multi-era collections without a clear whole-book placement are held. Sub-series indices follow chronology, not publication numbering.

catalogs.limitations: Publisher timeline diagrams establish epochs, interleaving anchors and concurrent branches, not exact dates for every book. Within concurrent branches this catalog is an explicitly curated linear extension, preserving series sequence; integer positions are display ranks, not fictional dates. Age of Magic begins at WWDE+235. Boxed sets, multiverse anthologies and uncited crossover positions remain held. This catalog is incomplete, not an exhaustive universe bibliography.

Specialist list is archived and incomplete. It cites Dragon Magazine #224 as its original basis. Its chronology is used rather than publication/recommended reading order. Legends time travel is held instead of silently placing War of the Twins before Time of the Twins.

Lensman's chronology gives approximate and disputed dates. The coauthor independently establishes the Fleet/Ringworld relationship. Anthology volumes and unestablished Man-Kzin continuity are not arbitrarily numbered. Telepath's Dance has conflicting author metadata in the original export and is held.
